7.7
Collaborative Research Workspace
Future versions can support collaborative workspaces where multiple researchers can
contribute to the same project.
Possible features include:
• Shared Workspaces
• Role-based Access Control
• Team Collaboration
• Document Version Control
• Activity Logs
7.8
Enhanced AI Capabilities
The AI engine can be further improved by integrating more advanced language models
and intelligent features such as:
• Automatic Research Paper Summarization
• Citation Recommendation
• Research Trend Analysis
• Literature Review Generation
• Automatic Reference Extraction
• AI-based Research Suggestions
7.9
Performance Optimization
Future work may also focus on improving system performance by:
• GPU-accelerated embeddings
• Distributed vector databases
• Faster indexing algorithms
• Intelligent document caching
• Parallel document processing
These improvements will reduce processing time for very large research collections.
